The Stock Market moves to Wall St. for player-to-player trading, Survive the Trenches opens below Rugpull Ridge, the lava zone lights up on Ember Coast, and new players start on Normie Island.

The Great Rug

The world. The internet became a world. Memes are alive here, and their power is Clout: the magic of being seen. The first memes, the Seven Originals, built the towns and each wove their Clout into a cape. Those seven OG Capes kept the world's Liquidity flowing. Rivers ran. Crops grew. Jokes landed.

The Rug. One Original, the trickster Dev, a hooded figure with no face but a loading spinner, drained the Liquidity and vanished. Rivers dropped and the memes soured: Shibe turned hostile, Wojak sank into despair, the coins became monsters. He calls himself The Rugpuller now, and he is hunting the other six capes. With all seven he gains Total Market Control and can rewrite every meme in his image.

You. A Normie who wakes at Castle Gigachad with a wiped wallet and no memory. Normies aren't made of Clout, which means the Rugpuller cannot edit you. That's why Froggo, the last free Original, recruits you.

Factions

Diamond Hands

The order that never sells. Stoic knights of HODL Heights with crystal gauntlets. Allies.

Paper Hands

Panic-sellers turned raiders, led by Jeet the Fleet from Rugpull Ridge. Enemies, but redeemable.

The Bots

Spam armies the Rugpuller farms from Spam Portals. Pure enemies.

The Based Council

The six surviving Originals, once reunited. Your employers in the late game.

Chapters

Chapter 1 · launch

The Great Rug

Wake up, meet Froggo, recover your seed phrase, defend the castle gate from the Bot Captain. Quests: Much Wow Such Cake · Wallet Not Found · Touch Grass · The Fish Are Rugged · Feels Bad, Man.
Chapter 2

Stonks and Bonds

The frozen Exchange, Paper Hands in Bear Market Woods, a bear with a SELL sign, and your first OG Cape.
Chapter 3

The Jeet Invasion

War is declared. Meme Wars opens. Behind enemy lines at Jeet's Fort.
Chapter 4

The Copium Mines

Dwarves who buy every dip, the first Vibe Altar, and the Mint Mother.
Chapter 5

The Burn

Where supply goes to die. The Burn Gauntlet and Burnzilla.
Chapter 6

The Final Rug

The Moon. The Liquidity Vault. Total Market Control. Beat the Rugpuller, or make him laugh.

Towns

Eight meme towns, a castle, and the land in between. Every town has its own bank, general store, forge and cooking range, a well, a fountain, market stalls, lamp posts that light up at night, a signpost and a Meme Telly ring. The Telly only takes you to a town you have walked into once, and the Grand Tour quest walks you through all eight in order, easiest first.

GIG

Castle Gigachad and Gigachad Town

Home

Where everyone wakes up. The castle on the hill, the herald at the gate, Froggo with the quests, and a town below it with the barracks, bank, store, tavern, chapel, smithy and kitchen. The Agility course runs along the castle wall, the Frozen Shibe sits on the frozen peak to the north, and the Meme Telly here is always open as your home teleport.

WOW

Wow Landing

Stop 1 on the Grand Tour

The first town down the road from the castle. Thatched cottages, the windmill, the church, and the easiest achievement diary in the game. Learn the ropes here before the roads get longer.

FRG

Froggo's Pond

Stop 2

A swamp town east of the castle, built on stilts over the water. Fish shacks, docks, lily pads and the shrine. The fishing spots are right off the boardwalks.

STK

Stonks City

Stop 3

The money town in the middle of the map, where every road crosses. Tall gothic row houses, the old Exchange and the clock tower. It rains here more than it should.

DMD

Diamond Hands

Stop 4

Blue-and-white manor houses in the north-west, with the hall, the spire and the yard. Copper Hills and its mines are a short walk away.

RUG

Rugpull Ridge

Stop 5

The south-west frontier. Boarded-up houses, the manor and the crypt, with the Wildlands and the Ratio Lord's lair beyond. The road south will lead to the Trenches.

HDL

HODL Heights

Stop 6

High in the north under the Copium Mountains. Log cabins, the lodge, the monastery and the bell tower. Cold, quiet, and a long way from a rug.

MUN

Moon Landing

Stop 7

The south-east, where the moon memes landed. Habitat pods, the dome, the antenna and the gantry, with the lunar lander and craters outside town. The Meme Caves open nearby.

CHD

Chad Falls

Stop 8

Red-roofed villas on the east coast by the sea, with the colosseum and the baths. The last stop on the Grand Tour, and the way out to Ember Coast once the land bridge opens.

New land, coming next

The world grew to the east and south in October. These are on the map now and get their buildings with the updates.

Wall St.

East coast, hugging the shore south of Froggo's Pond.

The Stock Market moves here: a street grid, brokers, a ticker board, and player-to-player trading once the servers arrive.

Ember Coast

North-east, over a thick land bridge from Chad Falls.

A volcano on its north tip and the lava zone around it: obsidian hut, furnace cave, lava bridge.

The Trenches

South, a mud peninsula below Rugpull Ridge.

Home of Survive the Trenches: ten waves of fresh launches, snipers, bundlers and The Rug.

Normie Island

South-east, alone in the sea.

The tutorial island new players start on, reached by portal only.

Quests

Froggo hands out most quests from his spot at Castle Gigachad; the Great Rug chapter brings three more quest givers. Finish the task, walk back to him, and claim the reward. Quest points show on your profile, and once every quest is done the Cape merchant sells you the Quest cape. Ten quests are in the game: five with Froggo, and Chapter 1, The Great Rug.

1 QP

Proof of Work

Defeat 3 memes of any kind. Froggo needs proof you can fight.

Needs: None
Rewards: 100 Attack XP, 30 Meme Coins, Party cake, 1 quest point
1 QP

The Bonk Problem

Defeat 3 Bonk Hounds before they bonk the kingdom.

Needs: Proof of Work
Rewards: 150 Strength XP, 40 Meme Coins, Potion, 1 quest point
1 QP

Wojak Blues

Defeat 5 Wojak Wanderers. It is over for them.

Needs: Proof of Work
Rewards: 150 Defence XP, 40 Meme Coins, Iron axe, 1 quest point
5 QP

The Ratio Lord

Defeat the Ratio Lord (level 75) in his lair. Check the world map.

Needs: The Bonk Problem, Wojak Blues
Rewards: 2,000 Attack XP, 1,000 Meme Coins, Ratio Blade, 5 quest points
2 QP

The Grand Tour

Walk to all eight meme towns in order, easiest first: Wow Landing, Froggo's Pond, Stonks City, Diamond Hands, Rugpull Ridge, HODL Heights, Moon Landing, Chad Falls. Each one you reach joins the Meme Telly.

Needs: Proof of Work
Rewards: 600 Agility XP, 500 Meme Coins, Big wish lamp, 2 quest points

Chapter 1: The Great Rug

1 QP

Much Wow, Such Cake

Chef Bagholder bought every ingredient at the top. Bring him an egg, a bucket of milk and a pot of flour from Wow Landing.

Needs: None
Rewards: 300 Cooking XP, 50 Meme Coins, Party cake, 1 quest point

Wallet Not Found

Froggo explains the Great Rug. Three forgetful Wojaks each remember one word of your seed phrase.

Needs: Much Wow, Such Cake
Rewards: A small XP lamp, 75 Meme Coins, Seed phrase scroll, 1 quest point
1 QP

Touch Grass

Farmer Ted's allotments are full of Doomscrollers. Plant a potato and tell each one to go outside.

Needs: None
Rewards: 400 Farming XP, 60 Meme Coins, 1 quest point
1 QP

The Fish Are Rugged

Fisherwoman Nemo's pond keeps draining. Search the muddy shallows and find out where the Liquidity goes.

Needs: Fishing level 5
Rewards: 600 Fishing XP, 80 Meme Coins, a meme hunt scroll, 1 quest point
2 QP

Feels Bad, Man

The Bot Captain and his Spam Bots attack the castle gate. Hold it, and Froggo trusts you with a secret.

Needs: The four quests above and Proof of Work
Rewards: 350 Attack, Strength and Defence XP, 250 Meme Coins, Cape fragment (Feels), 2 quest points

Coming with the updates

Chapter 2, Stonks and Bonds, Into the Trenches, and a quest for every new region: Wall St., Ember Coast and Normie Island.

Meme Capes

Capes are the prestige system. Every cape is earned or bought, and the way you got it shows: on your back, on the leaderboards, on your Cape Rack, and on your memecapes profile. Only the Burn and Rug Pit capes have combat stats, so a bought cape never beats an earned one in a fight.

Real pictures from the bag

Every meme, one cape, one crown. Worn in 3D with the hood and crown over your head. 100,000,000 Meme Coins at the Cape merchant.

The same cape without the hood and crown, for finishing every quest. 100,000 Meme Coins.

Beat the Meme Caves, bonk a Chad Brute, or finish a treasure trail.

One per skill at level 100, 1,000,000 Meme Coins each. Two skills at 100 and they get a gold border. Attack, Strength, Defence, Health, Prayer, Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Cooking, Smithing, Kindling, Agility, Bounty, Farming, Construction.

Genesis Capes and NFTs

Genesis Capes are limited runs of 100 per design, minted on Solana as cosmetics only. Every purchase splits 60% burned, 30% treasury, 10% creator, posted on-chain where anyone can check it. They are also earnable: the top 10 on each monthly hiscore get one minted free. They arrive after the token, not before.

Six story updates, three minigames, three new skills, and the cape that ties it together. Dates are targets, not promises; the game ships when it's fun.

How it works in the game today

🪙

Earn Meme Coins

Drops, quests, skilling, shops. The in-game money. Not a token.

🏦

Exchange at a bank

Starting rate 100 Meme Coins = 1 $CAPES. The rate steepens as the pot drains, so it lasts for years.

⏱️

100 a day cap

Every player can take out at most 100 $CAPES a day. No whales, no bots draining the pot.

Planned supply

Launch on a public bonding curve. Nothing is allocated in advance; the project buys its share publicly in the first minutes and locks it where everyone can watch.

WalletSharePurposeRule
Public82%Bought on the curve by anyone—
Player Pot10% (100,000,000)Paid out to players through the exchangePublic wallet, locked, 100/day per player
Treasury4%Server, art, adsMultisig, spending posted monthly
Creator4%The person building thisVested 12 months, no selling in month one

Burns come from play, not promises

Cosmetic drops

Limited capes and cosmetics bought with $CAPES: 60% burned, 30% treasury, 10% creator. Fixed quantities, burns posted on-chain.

Trade tax

When player trading opens, a small tax on every trade is paid in $CAPES and burned.

Sponsored monsters

Communities pay to put their mascot in the game. Paid in $CAPES bought on the market, half burned.

No staking yield. No revenue share. No price talk. The token is a cape you can trade, not a security.

FAQ

Is it really free?Yes. The game runs in your browser on a phone or a computer. No download, no account needed to try it.
Do I need crypto to play?No. Meme Coins are in-game currency. The $CAPES side is optional and comes later.
Is there a token?Not yet. When there is, it will be announced here first. Anything before that is fake.
What do $CAPES holders get?Hold at least 1% of all $CAPES in your own wallet and link it at any bank in the game: you get Cape Club membership free for as long as you keep 1%, and one free skin from the skin store every 14 days (the first one after 14 days of holding). Linking means signing a short free message in your wallet app. It is not a transaction, nothing moves, and we never ask for your seed phrase. The game checks the balance on the blockchain every day. Hold at least 3% for 14 days and your project can run a free partner ad: a billboard with your picture and an NPC in every meme town, plus a cape in your colour. Every ad is approved by hand, and everything comes down as soon as a check finds the wallet under 3%. Burn 1% of all $CAPES and your project gets the ad spot on this website's home page, shared with the other burners by how much each one burned (approval comes first, so you never burn for an ad we turn down). Perks are in-game only: holding $CAPES does not pay out money or tokens, and it is not an investment.
Is this connected to any other game?No. MemeCapes is an original game made by one person, inspired by the classic MMOs of the 2000s: tick-based combat, skills, and quests full of jokes. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any other game or company.
Who makes it?One builder, @Mrsnakebaby, with AI tools, building in public.
Can I buy a cape?Yes, with Meme Coins at the Cape merchant: a skill's cape once you reach level 100 in it, the Quest cape once every quest is done, and the MemeCape itself for 100,000,000. Genesis Capes come with $CAPES after the token. A custom cape with your own design can be ordered in the Shop; it is cosmetic only.
Will there be multiplayer?Yes. Online play is built: accounts, cloud saves, seeing other players, chat and player-to-player trades. It switches on with the game server; until then the game saves in your browser.
Are the memes licensed?MemeCapes is a parody. Characters are original interpretations; some well-known memes may be redesigned before launch after legal review.

Privacy Policy

Last updated . Short version: we don't run accounts, ads trackers or analytics, and we don't sell anything about you.

What stays on your device

Your character name, appearance, progress, settings and the fact that you accepted these policies are stored in your own browser (local storage). We don't receive them. You can delete them at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser.

What other services see

  • Hosting. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub receives your IP address and basic request data to serve the pages, under GitHub's privacy statement.
  • Fonts. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address, under Google's privacy policy.
  • Prices and payments. When you use the shop or the $CAPES deposit, your browser asks a public price service and a public Solana node about prices and transactions. Your wallet address and transactions are public on the blockchain by design.
  • Links. Links to X or other sites are covered by those sites' own policies.

What you send us

If you email us, message us or place a shop order, we see what you send (for example your email, X handle, wallet address and order details). We use it only to answer you and deliver your order, keep it as long as needed for that and for our records, and never sell it.

Wallets

We never ask for, see or store your seed phrase or private keys. Never type them into any website.

Children

MemeCapes is only for people 18 and older. We don't knowingly collect anything from anyone under 18. If you believe a child has sent us information, contact us and we will delete it.

Multiplayer will need an account and will store your game progress on our server. We will update this policy before that happens and ask you to agree again.
